name: dsh-open-dream-rsi
description: Let your coding agent dream: strategies must survive counterfactual replay before they earn trust. An offline self-improvement loop over an evolving world model — no fine-tuning, the LLM stays frozen. Speaks MCP. Ships its Python server inside the package — the only requirement is a system python3 (3.10+) on PATH — and the plugin's bridge serves the dreamer's LLM calls from the model your harness is already configured with (no API keys, no env, no extra endpoints).
author: patrykorwat
